summary: The team reviewed the mobile release, covering an Android crash, analytics migration, beta testing, and Dark Mode. Neha was assigned to fix the crash by March 3rd, and the group decided to switch analytics to Mixpanel and postpone Dark Mode to the next release. Open items include investigating a push notification bug, sending release notes, and confirming the App Store review timeline.
